decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 4 for the 12 month period).
fact: Causing a collision with car 16 at turn 3
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 12 was attempting an overtake on the inside of Car 16 at Turn 3 and understeered into the side of Car 16. This resulted in significant damage to Car 16 and its retirement. It is clear that Car 12 was wholly and predominantly to blame for the collision. We accordingly imposed a 10 second time penalty on Car 12.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Causing A Collision With Car 16
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
